_huong_dan: Thuong KHONG can sua file nay: chay run.bat roi vao tab Cai dat nhap 2 KEY. Neu muon sua tay: copy thanh 'config.json' roi dien llm_api_key + youtube_api_key. KHONG chia se config.json.

_ghi_chu.model_analyze: Model PHAN TICH + NHIN ANH (phan tich kenh, quet anh thumb). Nen la Gemini vi can 'mat'.
_ghi_chu.model_create: Model SANG TAO (tieu de, prompt thumbnail). Co the thu claude-sonnet-4-6 de tieu de 'muot' hon.
_ghi_chu.llm_model: Model du phong (tu dong dong bo = model_create khi luu trong tab Cai dat).
_ghi_chu.llm_reasoning: Che do suy luan: auto / minimal / low / medium / high / max / xhigh. De 'auto' la on.
_ghi_chu.youtube_api_key: Lay tai https://console.cloud.google.com -> bat 'YouTube Data API v3' -> tao API key.
